notes: Takeout only – no seating inside (Tabling). Hours 10:00–20:00 daily agree across Tabling, DiningCode and Daangn; no regular closing day, but it closes early once stock sells out, so go in the morning. Earlier reviews describe open-run queues from ~08:00; newer reviews say the Seongsu queue shrank after the Hongdae and Shinsegae Gangnam stores opened (2026). Other Korean branches: Hongdae, Shinsegae Dept. Store Gangnam. A 2025 guide lists the address as 316-50 Seongsu-dong 2-ga, which is the lot address for the same site. Coordinates from one source only.
